items.label: Large Dog Crate Furniture
items.value: Measures 86.7 in wide x 26.8 in deep x 38.1 in high. This versatile dog crate provides ample room for two large dogs to move around freely, while maintaining an unobstructed view from multiple angles to keep them at ease

items.label: Removable Dividers
items.value: To accommodate dogs of varying sizes, this double dog crate features removable dividers, allowing you to flexibly transform it into either separate compartments or an open play area

items.label: Multifunctional Dog Kennel
items.value: This wooden dog crate furniture fits various decor styles. It provides a comfortable living area for your dog, doubles as a TV stand or side table to save space, and features a spacious tabletop for placing decorations

items.label: Sturdy and Chew-Resistant
items.value: This XXL double dog cage is made of high-quality particleboard and iron pipes. Thickened wood and metal pipes boost sturdiness, bite resistance, load capacity. Each door has two metal locks to enhance stability

items.label: 4 Drawer Storage
items.value: This dog kennel furniture features four convenient drawers to keep your home organized. Perfect for storing pet essentials such as pet toys, snacks and food, and even household items, helping you maintain a neat and organized space

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: This premium dog crate comes with clear installation instructions and clearly labeled parts for quick and easy installation, making it a perfect addition to any pet-friendly home, upgrading your pet space and also serving as home decor
